tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Convert text to speech with YarnGPT. Pass text (required, max 2000 characters) and voice (required). response_format defaults to mp3 (mp3, wav, opus, or flac). Use list_voices to discover voices. API key comes from global_variables.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List all available YarnGPT voices with names and descriptions. Use before text_to_speech when the user asks which voices exist or which voice to pick. Voices: Idera, Emma, Zainab, Osagie, Wura, Jude, Chinenye, Tayo, Regina, Femi, Adaora, Umar, Mary, Nonso, Remi, Adam.
